question.text: Let $f(x)$ be a second degree polynomial. If $f(1)=f(-1)$ and $p, q, r$ are in A.P., then $f^{\prime}(p), f^{\prime}(q), f^{\prime}(r)$ are

options.text: neither in A.P. or G.P. or H.P.

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & f(-1)=f(1) \Rightarrow b=0 \\ & f(x)=a x^2+c \quad \Rightarrow f^{\prime}(x)=2 a x\end{aligned}$
